description: The Extended Deployment Pack is one of the larger military-style packs Rothco has introduced; measuring 21" X 13" X 10" the tactical pack fits in size between Rothco's Global Assault Pack & Rothco's Move Out Bag. This pack is not only one of our largest tactical pack it features a ton of organizational compartments and pockets including; one main compartment measuring 21” x 13” x 5”1/2 with two zippered mesh pockets, one interior organizer panel with 3 pen slots, 4 open top pockets and 2 hook & loop pockets, a front zippered compartment with large mesh zippered pocket, and interior open top pocket with 3 ¾ swivel clip. And if that wasn't enough the pack also features 3 small side zippered pouches with MOLLE loops and removable top pouch, bottom front pocket with MOLLE loops and two mesh zippered pockets, a large side zippered pouch with MOLLE attachments and an exterior side zipper compartment on front flap. With all those pockets and room for equipment, it was important to also design this pack for long-lasting comfort. Rothco’s Extended Deployment Pack features adjustable padded shoulder straps with quick release buckles, a breathable padded mesh back and a removable and adjustable padded waist belt with quick release buckles. In addition, this MOLLE compatible tactical pack is also hydration compatible with a back zippered compartment for a hydration bladder with a pass-through slot for the hose.
